prompt: Create an original 60 second lo-fi instrumental hip hop instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: Rhodes piano, muted drums, warm bass. Style: laid-back swung beat and hazy jazz harmony. Tempo approximately 70 BPM; D major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A calm and reflective instrumental piece featuring a gentle piano melody, warm string pads, a smooth bassline, and light, brushed drums.
description.zh: 一首平静而富有沉思感的纯音乐，以柔和的钢琴旋律、温暖的弦乐衬底、流畅的贝斯线和轻柔的鼓点为特色。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
